btts_and_clean_sheet#cross_tier_lambda_f.description: In Copa del Rey, Israeli Cup and Copa do Brasil early rounds the weaker side lambda (the binding quantity for BTTS) is poorly identified; the cross-tier link soc.cross_tier_strength_link and soc.favourite_rotation_in_mismatch are defined in the handicap_and_exact_score record, not in the catalog yet.
btts_and_clean_sheet#cross_tier_lambda_f.what_would_resolve: Share the handicap record cross-tier inputs after catalog merge and attach them here; test min-lambda calibration on cross-tier cup games.
btts_and_clean_sheet#cross_tier_lambda_f.classification_rationale: soc.cross_tier_strength_link and soc.favourite_rotation_in_mismatch now exist in the catalog inputs and are attached to handicap_and_exact_score, but neither appears in the btts_and_clean_sheet inputs or stages, so the weaker-side lambda in cross-tier cup ties has no defined source in this record; the min-lambda calibration itself is empirical.
btts_and_clean_sheet#cross_tier_lambda_f.catalog_action: Attach soc.cross_tier_strength_link and soc.favourite_rotation_in_mismatch to the btts_and_clean_sheet record (inputs list and the stage that sets each side's lambda), stating they apply to cross-division cup ties (Copa del Rey, Israeli Cup, Copa do Brasil early rounds).

competition_head_to_head#gap_coaching_sc.description: Mid-season managerial change, tactical shift and a pending sacking or appointment change points-per-game and no listed input captures them; effect size and persistence are debated (this entry merges the earlier mid_season_manager_effect item).
competition_head_to_head#gap_coaching_sc.what_would_resolve: Event study of league points-per-game before and after managerial changes over 10 seasons with matched controls, then define a manager-change input.
competition_head_to_head#gap_coaching_sc.classification_rationale: The catalog defines the manager-change mechanism (soc.transfers: manager-change flag with matches since change and prior/in-season rating re-blend; soc.manager_dismissal_hazard for a pending sacking), but neither is attached to competition_head_to_head, whose finish-ahead contracts span the rest of the season; the effect size itself is empirical.
competition_head_to_head#gap_coaching_sc.catalog_action: Attach soc.transfers (manager-change flag, rating re-blend) and soc.manager_dismissal_hazard to the competition_head_to_head record and its table-order stage, so a future in-window change is simulated as hazard x strength shift; leave the shift magnitude to the event study.

first_half_and_period#gap_environment.description: Heat, humidity, altitude and pitch reduce second-half intensity relative to the first; the size of the effect on the 1H/2H goal split by league and month is not established and the catalog weather input is not tied to halves.
first_half_and_period#gap_environment.what_would_resolve: Regress 2H share of goals on kickoff temperature/humidity and altitude using multi-season data with kickoff hour as control.
first_half_and_period#gap_environment.classification_rationale: soc.weather exists (heat, humidity, altitude at kickoff) but is not attached to first_half_and_period, and no interaction ties it to the 1H/2H goal split even though half variants are ~268 ledger series; this is a missing input link and interaction, with the effect size left to data.
first_half_and_period#gap_environment.catalog_action: Attach soc.weather to first_half_and_period and author an interaction soc.weather x soc.period_split (temperature/humidity/altitude shifting the second-half share of lambda) in the half-split stage, with the regression on kickoff weather named as its test.

first_to_score_event#archetype_mismatch.description: After the reconciliation the key holds two contract families: 32 First Team to Score series (target verified from rules text) and 37 Method of Victory/Finish series (23 MOV, 14 MOF) whose settlement is unseen; the MOV/MOF stages (s2-s4, s7) are untested against any contract text.
first_to_score_event#archetype_mismatch.what_would_resolve: Rules text for at least one knockout MOF and one league MOV series, or splitting the Method series into their own key.
first_to_score_event#archetype_mismatch.classification_rationale: Series mapping defect: the series ledger files 42 Method of Victory/Finish rows (e.g. KXUCLMOF, KXFACUPMOV, KXWCMOF, KXWCLONGESTPEN) under first_to_score_event while the catalog carries a dedicated unreg:knockout_method_of_victory record with extra-time and shootout inputs; the two records disagree on where these series are modelled.
first_to_score_event#archetype_mismatch.catalog_action: Re-map the 42 MOV/MOF ledger rows from first_to_score_event to unreg:knockout_method_of_victory (series_remap_proposals.json, then ledger), drop stages s2-s4/s7 from first_to_score_event, and confirm the knockout record's contract_review covers both MOV and MOF settlement.

relegation_qualification_advancement#gap.description: Mid-season managerial changes ('new manager bounce') are a recognised driver of relegation-zone teams, yet no input quantifies their effect size or timing, and the catalog only holds a manager-change flag under transfers.
relegation_qualification_advancement#gap.what_would_resolve: Event study of points per game after in-season manager changes for bottom-six teams across top leagues with matched controls.
relegation_qualification_advancement#gap.classification_rationale: Relegation-zone sackings are frequent, yet the record attaches neither soc.transfers (manager-change flag, rating re-blend) nor soc.manager_dismissal_hazard, so a mid-season change in the remaining-season simulation has no input; the bounce magnitude itself is empirical.
relegation_qualification_advancement#gap.catalog_action: Attach soc.manager_dismissal_hazard and soc.transfers to relegation_qualification_advancement stage s2 (remaining-fixture simulation), simulating in-season dismissals for bottom-six clubs and applying the re-blended strength after a change.

relegation_qualification_advancement#pla.description: EFL promotion via play-offs is a short knockout tournament after the regular season, and no input models the play-off stage or the semi-final tie structure.
relegation_qualification_advancement#pla.what_would_resolve: Add a play-off bracket model fitted to historical play-off results (about 20 seasons of EFL data).
relegation_qualification_advancement#pla.classification_rationale: The settlement includes the EFL Championship play-off route (3rd-6th, two-legged semis 3v6/4v5, single final at Wembley with extra time and penalties), but stage s3 only mentions a play-off mini-tournament; no input maps regular-season rank to promotion via that bracket (soc.playoff_format_conversion is title-only and attached elsewhere).
relegation_qualification_advancement#pla.catalog_action: Author in relegation_qualification_advancement s3 a promotion play-off bracket for KX promotion series: P(promoted)=P(top 2)+sum over ranks 3-6 of P(rank) x P(win bracket), composed from soc.tie_advancement_state_tree (two-leg semis) and soc.extra_time_shootout_model (final), or extend soc.playoff_format_conversion to promotion.

soccer_special_and_host#host_result_seri.description: The host-nation result series sit in competition_winner_and_top_n (KXWCHOSTWIN) and relegation_qualification_advancement (KXWCHOSTKO, KXWCHOSTSTAGE), with the best-host comparison KXWCBESTHOST in competition_head_to_head; this key keeps only host announcements (KXWCHOST, KXCOPAAMERICAHOST, KXCLUBWCHOST), whose 'Source Agencies' are undefined and whose co-host outcomes are non-exclusive.
soccer_special_and_host#host_result_seri.what_would_resolve: Definition of Source Agencies in the host-announcement rules and the receiving records' coverage of host-result series.
soccer_special_and_host#host_result_seri.classification_rationale: Series mapping defect: the ledger files KXWCHOSTWIN and KXWCHOSTKO under soccer_special_and_host, whose record models only host announcements, while the gap text places them in competition_winner_and_top_n and relegation_qualification_advancement; KXWCHOSTSTAGE is in relegation and KXWCBESTHOST is NO_LISTED_MARKETS. Ledger and records disagree.
soccer_special_and_host#host_result_seri.catalog_action: Re-map KXWCHOSTWIN to competition_winner_and_top_n and KXWCHOSTKO to relegation_qualification_advancement in the ledger (via series_remap_proposals.json), and confirm those records' stages carry host-nation advantage (soc.home_advantage) for them.

team_points_and_margin#gap_coaching_sche.description: A managerial change or tactical regime shift changes a club's expected points per match for the rest of the season at once; no input quantifies the effect, and for contenders it moves both the points threshold and the champion margin.
team_points_and_margin#gap_coaching_sche.what_would_resolve: Event-study of PPG before and after managerial changes in top leagues with matched controls.
team_points_and_margin#gap_coaching_sche.classification_rationale: team_points_and_margin attaches rotation_index and motivation but neither soc.transfers (manager-change flag, rating re-blend) nor soc.manager_dismissal_hazard, so a change during the season, which moves both the points threshold and champion margin, has no input; the size of the shift is empirical.
team_points_and_margin#gap_coaching_sche.catalog_action: Attach soc.transfers and soc.manager_dismissal_hazard to team_points_and_margin and its points_total_distribution stage, simulating in-season dismissals and re-blended strength after a change; effect size left to the event study.

total_goals#gap_situational_schedule_mot.description: Late-season dead rubbers, rotation after midweek ties, and stakes alter scoring environment (more open or more cautious) but the catalog attaches no stakes or rotation inputs to totals and the sign of the effect is not established.
total_goals#gap_situational_schedule_mot.what_would_resolve: Backtest totals residuals against stakes leverage and rotation indices in league matches over 5 seasons.
total_goals#gap_situational_schedule_mot.classification_rationale: total_goals attaches no stakes or rotation input (soc.stakes_leverage, soc.motivation and soc.rotation_index are absent from its inputs and stages) although soc.motivation itself states stakes push totals; a missing input link. The sign and size are empirical (see stakes_effect_sign).
total_goals#gap_situational_schedule_mot.catalog_action: Attach soc.stakes_leverage and soc.rotation_index to the total_goals record (lambda stage), with an interaction stating dead-rubber/six-pointer leverage shifts both lambdas with unknown sign, tested by pooled residual regression.
